players.product: GEM 63 / GEM 63XL solid rocket boosters for the Atlas V and Vulcan launch vehicles

quarterly_data.signal: Northrop Grumman 10-K: Space Systems key programs include the 63-inch GEM 63 and extended GEM 63XL solid rocket boosters that provide lift capability for the Atlas V and Vulcan launch vehicles; 2025 Space Systems sales included a $168 million increase on GEM 63 as the program ramps.
Northrop Grumman 10-K: its largest customer is the U.S. government, which accounted for 84 percent of 2025 sales (87 percent in 2024, 86 percent in 2023).
